description.en: Check health, response time, and disk/memory usage across services
description.de: Health, Antwortzeit und Disk/Memory-Nutzung über mehrere Services prüfen

instructions.de: Prüfe Service-Health. Variablen: service_urls (zeilengetrennte HTTP/HTTPS URLs), timeout_seconds (default 10).
instructions.en: Check service health. Variables: service_urls (newline-separated HTTP/HTTPS URLs), timeout_seconds (default 10).

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo "=== System Resources ==="
echo "Hostname: $(hostname)"
echo "Uptime: $(uptime -p 2>/dev/null || uptime)"
echo ""
echo "--- Disk Usage ---"
df -h | grep -v tmpfs | grep -v udev
echo ""
echo "--- Memory Usage ---"
free -h 2>/dev/null || vm_stat 2>/dev/null | head -10
echo ""
echo "--- Top Processes (CPU) ---"
ps aux --sort=-%cpu 2>/dev/null | head -6 || ps aux | head -6
echo "=== Resource Check Complete ==="

set -euo pipefail
URL="{{ service_url }}"
TIMEOUT={{ timeout_seconds }}
TIMEOUT=${TIMEOUT:-10}
echo "=== Checking $URL ==="
RESULT=$(curl -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "$URL" 2>&1 || echo "FAILED")
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESULT" | awk '{print $1}')
RESP_TIME=$(echo "$RESULT" | awk '{print $2}')
if [ "$RESULT" = "FAILED" ]; then
  echo "DOWN: $URL (connection failed)"
elif [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 500 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $URL returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE (${RESP_TIME})"
elif [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 400 ]; then
  echo "WARN: $URL returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE (${RESP_TIME})"
else
  echo "OK: $URL HTTP $HTTP_CODE (${RESP_TIME})"
fi

command.de: Erstelle einen strukturierten Health-Report basierend auf den Ressourcen- und Service-Prüfergebnissen. Markiere kritische Services, ungewöhnlich hohe Ressourcennutzung und gib konkrete Empfehlungen. Format: Executive Summary, dann Details pro Service.
command.en: Create a structured health report based on the resource and service check results. Flag critical services and unusually high resource usage, and give concrete recommendations. Format: executive summary, then details per service.
